visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A red block animation appears on a black screen, transforming into the letter 'K' in a style reminiscent of Netflix's intro. The background is pitch black, and the letter has a subtle gradient texture. (2) A young man wearing a teal-and-white tracksuit with the number 120 on his back walks down a hallway toward another man dressed in an orange dress and yellow collared shirt with pigtails, imitating the Squid Game doll. The setting is a modern indoor space with dark walls and bright ceiling vents. (3) The man in the tracksuit faces the camera, looking skeptical and confident. A transition occurs to a pink and blue acupressure mat placed on a dark carpet. A green rope lies across the mat. The lighting is bright and even. (4) The man attempts to jump rope on the spiked mat while barefoot. He exhibits pained facial expressions, including squinting and open-mouthed gasping. He eventually falls to the ground in agony, his body sprawled across the floor. (5) A sniper-scope overlay appears, zooming in on the doll character's expressionless face as he looks directly at the camera. The scene cuts to the man in the tracksuit standing at a grey counter with red and green 'YES/NO' buttons. (6) A person dressed as a red-suited guard presents various 7-ELEVEN products: Sanrio-themed fans, F1 Ferrari toy cars, and Korean 'Quokka School' corn snacks. The man looks stressed, rubbing his head in indecision. (7) The man is shown presenting a large tray filled with 7-ELEVEN merchandise, including Jinro Soju, figurines, and snacks. He changes between the tracksuit and the doll costume, smiling and gesturing towards the products against a modern indoor backdrop with high-rise views visible through windows.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a distinctive, low-frequency 'Tudum' impact sound associated with brand intros. (2) A synthesized female voice sings the melodic 'Mugunghwa kkochi pieot seumnida' phrase from Squid Game. This is punctuated by a sharp, high-pitched electronic chime. (3) A male voice speaks with rapid, confident delivery and moderate pitch. An upbeat, high-tempo pop instrumental swells in the background with a prominent kick drum beat. (4) Percussive thudding sounds of footsteps on a mat are heard, followed by several sharp 'whoosh' sounds of a rope. The male speaker lets out high-arousal yelps and grunts of physical pain. (5) A mechanical whirring and clicking sound signifies a lens zoom effect. (6) Two distinct electronic buzzer sounds—a low-pitched 'buzz' and a higher 'ding'—occur in quick succession. The male narrator’s voice becomes more urgent and high-pitched. (7) The music transitions into a bright, cheerful commercial jingle. Sound effects of rustling plastic packaging and the sharp clink of glass bottles are layered over the clear, professional-style promotional narration. (8) A final comical 'ding' sound effect marks the conclusion of the audio track as the narrator invites listeners to visit the store.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous parody of the popular 'Squid Game' series to capture attention before transitioning into a promotional showcase for 7-ELEVEN Taiwan's new themed product line. The creator uses the 'Red Light, Green Light' challenge and the acupressure mat 'punishment' to generate engagement through physical comedy, followed by an enthusiastic product unboxing and promotional offer explanation to drive sales.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of 7-ELEVEN logo, mention of pre-order dates (6/25), and detailed promotional discounts for specific items.
